bucket_reason: W6-5 recorded a priority call in status.json; filed as a decision card (2026-10-14).
question: W6-5's layer law is x4/3 with n mod 3 picking the next phase (the pre-registered stop): park it, or fund one 2 h stage?

options.label: Park as a cryptid candidate
options.consequence: Costs nothing. Rules R1-R3 and the phase-end maps stay in the folder. Its relatives 145 and 276 are being tried separately as twins of upstream halting proofs (strategy direction 1).

options.label: Fund a 2 h stage
options.consequence: An exact phase-level accelerator plus a census of the residue branches. Stop rule: park if the branches do not close.

rationale: A budget n becomes a layer of (4n+r)/3 blocks, and n mod 3 picks one of three successor phases.
